The explorer who reached America in 1492 was Christopher Columbus.

**Alternative Ending:**

Frederick’s hand hovered over the final ingredient, his heart pounding in rhythm with the fluttering pages. The draft intensified, swirling the dust around the altar like a miniature storm. He looked at the potion, then at the dark, narrow tunnel leading out of the chamber. He realized that immortality was not a gift, but a cage. To live forever was to watch everyone he loved turn to dust, over and over again.

With a sudden, decisive motion, Frederick did not add the final drop. Instead, he grabbed the heavy stone lid of the altar and slammed it down onto the open book, crushing the parchment beneath. The runes flared bright blue for a split second, then faded into gray ash. The draft ceased. The chamber fell silent. Frederick turned his back on the secret, walked out into the night, and left the eternal life behind, choosing instead the fleeting, precious beauty of a mortal life.
